![list](194,259,727,283)
- Select tuples of the loan relation where the branch name is “GMU”.

![formula](343,285,528,309) $\sigma_{Bname = 'GMU'} (Loan)$

![list](193,318,706,342)
- Find all tuples in which the amount of loan is more than \$12000.

![formula](250,340,430,366) $\sigma_{amount > 12000} (Loan)$

![list](191,377,847,401)
- Find those tuples pertaining to loans of more than \$ 12000 made by “GMU” branch.

![formula](245,401,757,431) $\sigma_{amount > 12000 \text{ AND } Bname = 'GMU'} (Loan) \quad \text{or,} \quad R1 \cap R2$

![list](188,437,559,457)
- List all loan numbers and the amount of loan.

![formula](249,459,462,488) $\Pi_{Loan\#, Amount} \quad Loan$

![list](188,496,614,516)
- Find the names of all customers who live in “Fairfax”.

![formula](264,516,594,551) $\Pi_{name} \left( \sigma_{(-city = 'Fairfax')} (Customers) \right)$

![list](188,557,850,575)
- Find the names of all bank customers who have either an account or a loan or both.

![formula](253,574,670,605) $\Pi_{name} (Depositor) \cup \Pi_{name} (Borrower)$

![list](188,616,829,635)
- Find the names of all customers of the bank who have an account but not a loan.

![formula](264,637,648,668) $\Pi_{name} (Depositor) - \Pi_{name} (Borrower)$

![list](187,675,753,694)
- Find the names of all customers who have both a loan and an account.

![formula](273,692,683,731) $\Pi_{name} (Depositor) \cap \Pi_{name} (Borrower)$
